narr: Deep monsoon moisture remained across northern Arizona which allowed the formation of strong thunderstorms with heavy rain that produced flash flooding.
ev: A storm chaser posted a video of flash flooding in the Cameron area on Twitter.
A stream gauge reported a 1.6 foot rise on Moenkopi Wash.
Street flooding on South Milton was reported (videos) on social media.
Reports of flooding on the Hopi Nation included First Mesa, Highway 264, Polacca Wash, and other locations.
Flooding was reported in Alberson Wash/Rose Creek, Lynx Creek, and Agua Fria River all the way to Skull Valley.
